name: family-tree
description: 可私有部署的电子族谱与亲属关系图

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @family-tree/api" "npm run dev -w @family-tree/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @family-tree/api && npm run build -w @family-tree/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @family-tree/api && npm run test -w @family-tree/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @family-tree/api && npm run lint -w @family-tree/web
